headline: Coordination is not the same as legitimate action.
lede: Frameworks can spawn agents, route work, and persist execution state. Ateles keeps the organization around that work: roles, priorities, authority, handoffs, and accountability.

items.title: Read the design
items.body: See how roles, priorities, handoffs, checkpoints, and accountability fit together.

items.title: Compare the boundary
items.body: See what a standing agent organization adds beyond routing one run.
